name: token-ideas
description: Ideas — a drag-and-drop board for what to build next in Token Tracker and Token Town. Shared memory between the user and the agent fleets: ideas.json is the source of truth, IDEAS.md is the readable rendering.

scripts._comment: src/main.js, never '.': electron resolves a folder arg like require() and would pick up ../ideas.json instead. Electron itself is borrowed from town/ — nothing to install here.
